entries.name: ecc-command-build-fix
entries.description: ECC command adaptation: Detect the project build system and incrementally fix build/type errors with minimal safe changes.
entries.notes: Run only tools already installed in the target project; never install missing dependencies or fetch packages. Keep fixes minimal and stop for architectural changes.

entries.name: ecc-command-test-coverage
entries.description: ECC command adaptation: Analyze coverage, identify gaps, and generate missing tests toward the target threshold.
entries.notes: Use only locally available test/coverage tools; never let npx download packages. Generate tests only within the explicitly requested project scope.

entries.name: ecc-command-update-docs
entries.description: ECC command adaptation: Sync documentation from source-of-truth files such as scripts, schemas, routes, and exports.
entries.notes: Limit documentation edits to the user-requested scope; do not run generated project scripts or create unrequested files.
